# Markdown Report

> Build Markdown reports with Python.


Tycho Engineering, MIT License

## Pages

- [mdreport](index.html.md): Build Markdown reports programmatically using a chainable fluent interface. Add headings, text, list...
- [Usage examples](usage.html.md): Create a `MarkdownReport`, add content, and then render or save it.
- [API reference](api-reference.html.md): Bases: [`object`](https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#object)
- [Extensions](extensions.html.md): Create a block when the report methods do not support the content you need.
